traits.name: Thoughtsense
traits.text: (divination, mental, occult); The neothelid uses its mind as a precise sense at the listed range to notice all non-mindless creatures.

traits.name: Dimensional Wormhole
traits.text: ⬲ (conjuration, occult, teleportation); Trigger A creature the neothelid is aware of uses a teleportation effect; The neothelid creates an extradimensional wormhole at the triggering creature's initial location that persists for up to 1 minute. If the neothelid moves into the wormhole's space, the neothelid teleports to the same destination as the triggering creature.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (acid, evocation, occult); The neothelid breathes a spray of acid that deals 16d6 (16d6) acid damage in a 60-foot cone (DC 38 basic Reflex save). The neothelid can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Instant Suggestion
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature fails a Will save against a spell or effect created by the neothelid Effect The neothelid casts a suggestion spell it has available on the creature that failed its Will save.

traits.name: Lashing Tongues
traits.text: ⬺ The neothelid's four tongues lash out in a frenzy at several targets. It makes up to four rasping tongue Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the neothelid's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the neothelid makes all of its attacks.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +28 (reach 15 feet); Damage 3d12+13 (3d12+13) piercing plus Improved Grab

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ rasping tongue +28 (agile, fatal d10, reach 25 feet); Damage 3d8+13 (3d8+13) slashing
